$schema: Dependency allowlist for widget and template development. Only packages listed here can be imported in src/widgets/ and src/themes/. To add a new package, raise a PR with justification and bundle size impact.

blocked_with_reason.lodash: Use native JS methods (Array.map, filter, reduce) or import specific function from lodash-es
blocked_with_reason.axios: Use native fetch() via page builder dataSources — widgets should not make HTTP requests directly
blocked_with_reason.jquery: Use React patterns — direct DOM manipulation is not allowed in widgets
blocked_with_reason.styled-components: Use Tailwind utility classes — the project uses Tailwind for all styling
blocked_with_reason.emotion: Use Tailwind utility classes — the project uses Tailwind for all styling
blocked_with_reason.@emotion/react: Use Tailwind utility classes — the project uses Tailwind for all styling
blocked_with_reason.@emotion/styled: Use Tailwind utility classes — the project uses Tailwind for all styling
blocked_with_reason.chart.js: Heavy charting library (~60KB). Discuss with core team if charting is needed
blocked_with_reason.d3: Heavy visualization library (~80KB). Discuss with core team if needed
blocked_with_reason.animate.css: Use CSS transform animations or Tailwind animate utilities
blocked_with_reason.react-query: Use swr (already approved) for client-side data fetching, or page builder dataSources for server-side
blocked_with_reason.@tanstack/react-query: Use swr (already approved) for client-side data fetching, or page builder dataSources for server-side
blocked_with_reason.framer-motion: Use CSS transitions/transforms or Tailwind animate. Framer adds ~30KB to bundle
blocked_with_reason.gsap: Use CSS transitions/transforms. GSAP adds ~30KB and requires license for commercial use
blocked_with_reason.swiper: Use embla-carousel-react (already approved) — lighter and already in the project
